question: How extensive is the paralyzing power gained by the practitioner?
premises: The practitioner can paralyze the entire world.
Paralyzing a desired person is a lesser feat.
The power is rhetorically emphasized as vast.
inference: One can paralyze the entire world, so paralyzing a desired person is certainly possible.
plain_english: One can paralyze the entire world—how much more so a desired person.
